notes.title: Version 1.0.8
notes.content:
Updated Ren'Py engine to 8.1.0.
 Updated "More games" section in Extras menu.

notes.title: Version 1.0.7
notes.content:
Adjusted mid-combat descriptive text to be less random and added more variants to cycle through. As a result, the text should repeat words less often and feel more varied.
Improved the UI. (Gallery now shows all CG on one screen. Increased the number of save slots.)
Updated Ren'Py engine from 7.4.2 to 8.0.0 and streamlined code to hopefully make the game run faster and more efficiently.
